concepts.name: 暖陶折页
concepts.prompt: Minimal editorial flat icon. Warm ivory full-bleed background. One bold terracotta angular folded speech-bubble glyph, built from two interlocking planes and a clear negative-space opening. Asymmetric but balanced; exceptionally restrained, crisp geometry, absolutely no gradients or tiny decoration.

concepts.name: 黑白回环
concepts.prompt: Swiss modernist black-and-white icon. Porcelain white background, one thick matte-black continuous open loop that subtly suggests a conversational comma. Graphic black silhouette with generous negative space; two-color flat vector aesthetic, no shadows, no ornamental details.

concepts.name: 深蓝轨道
concepts.prompt: Cobalt blue precision-tech icon. Saturated deep cobalt full-bleed square; a single clean white elliptical orbit ring with one bold small satellite disc, tilted 35 degrees. Minimal three-dimensional depth only on the orbit edge, high contrast and refined optical balance; no galaxy, no stars.

concepts.name: 青玉之门
concepts.prompt: Contemporary East Asian geometric brand icon. Muted dark-jade background, an elegant luminous pale-jade gateway made of two broad curved arch pillars with a centered negative-space passage. Flat architectural, calming, very simple and strong. No literal building scene, no lettering.

concepts.name: 银色棱镜
concepts.prompt: Luxury industrial-material icon. Near-black charcoal full-bleed background. One substantial brushed-silver faceted prism, a sculptural folded diamond with three clean planes, subtle chrome highlights, tiny controlled specular accents, no lens flare. A powerful solid silhouette at thumbnail size.

concepts.name: 琥珀字标
concepts.prompt: Warm modern typographic brand icon. Rich amber-orange full-bleed background. One original cream abstract capital A constructed from a broad folded ribbon, a striking triangular counter and one subtle cut in the crossbar. The A is the only character; flat geometric poster aesthetics, no words or other symbols.

concepts.name: 紫电像素
concepts.prompt: Refined retro-digital icon, not a game screenshot. Deep violet full-bleed square, one sharply pixelated pale-lilac speech bubble formed on a deliberate 8-bit grid, with a tiny contrasting electric-lime square cursor in the center. Flat, minimal, strong blocky silhouette; no glow, no gradients, no letters.

concepts.name: 珊瑚瓷语
concepts.prompt: Soft sculptural product icon. Very light warm stone full-bleed background, two interlocking chunky coral-red porcelain speech forms with rounded sculptural edges, one continuous complementary negative-space opening. Subtle physical ceramic shading and contact shadow, sophisticated warm material, no toy face, no glossy plastic.

selectionNote: 以用户随后附上的黑底银色金属 A 图片为最终选择
